conversion_help_content:
Conversion Parameters Help

📁 Output Format

What it is: The file format to which the source file will be converted.

When to use:

  • MP4 - universal format, suitable for most devices and platforms
  • AVI - old format, good compatibility with legacy software
  • MKV - supports multiple tracks, subtitles, high quality
  • MOV - Apple format, best for Mac/iOS devices
  • WEBM - optimized for web playback
  • MP3 - audio only, universal format for music
  • FLAC - audio only, lossless quality

🎬 Video Codec

What it is: Video compression algorithm.

When to use:

  • H.264 (libx264) - best balance of quality and size, universal compatibility
  • H.265 (libx265) - better compression, smaller file size, but requires more resources
  • VP9 - open standard, good for web content
  • AV1 - newest codec, excellent compression, but slow processing

📐 Resolution

What it is: Video size in pixels (width × height).

When to use:

  • Original - keep original resolution
  • 1920×1080 (Full HD) - standard for most screens
  • 1280×720 (HD) - smaller file size, suitable for mobile devices
  • 3840×2160 (4K) - high quality for large screens

📊 Video Bitrate

What it is: Amount of data per second for video. Higher = better quality, but larger file size.

Recommendations:

  • 1-3 Mbps - for mobile devices, low quality
  • 5-10 Mbps - good quality for Full HD
  • 15-25 Mbps - high quality for Full HD
  • 35-50 Mbps - for 4K video

🔊 Audio Bitrate

What it is: Audio quality. Higher = better sound, but larger file size.

Recommendations:

  • 128 kbps - acceptable quality for speech
  • 192 kbps - good quality for music
  • 320 kbps - high quality, close to CD

💡 General Tips

  • For YouTube: MP4 + H.264 + 1080p + 8-12 Mbps
  • For mobile: MP4 + H.264 + 720p + 3-5 Mbps
  • For archiving: MKV + H.265 + original resolution
  • For fast processing: use hardware acceleration (if available)

codec_help_content:
Video Codec Help

H.264 (AVC) - Recommended for most cases

  • Good quality at small file size
  • Wide device compatibility
  • Fast encoding

H.265 (HEVC) - For maximum quality

  • Better compression, smaller file size
  • High video quality
  • Slower encoding

VP9 - Open standard

  • Good compression
  • Free codec
  • Web browser support

AV1 - Latest standard

  • Best compression
  • Open standard
  • Very slow encoding

audio_format_help:
MP3 - Most popular format
• Good compression and quality
• Supported by all devices
• Recommended for general use

AAC - Modern format
• Better quality than MP3 at same size
• Used in iTunes and YouTube
• Good for mobile devices

FLAC - Lossless quality
• Preserves original quality
• Large file sizes
• For audiophiles and archiving

WAV - Uncompressed format
• Maximum quality
• Very large files
• For professional work
audio_quality_help:
Audio quality (bitrate):

96 kbps - Low quality
• For speech and podcasts
• Minimum file size

128 kbps - Acceptable quality
• For background music
• Space saving

192 kbps - Good quality (recommended)
• Optimal balance of quality and size
• Suitable for most cases

256 kbps - High quality
• For quality listening
• Noticeably larger size

320 kbps - Maximum quality
• Practically indistinguishable from CD
• Largest files
